title: Counterexamples to a conjecture and improved bounds for bipanchromatic colorings
summary: We study the bipanchromatic number $χ_B$, introduced by Lalou et al. (Discrete Appl. Math. 391 (2026), 511-522) as the maximum number of colors in a panchromatic hypergraph coloring where every color appears at least twice. They show that merging uniquely occurring colors in a maximum panchromatic coloring gives the lower bound $β=χ_P-\lceilα/2\rceil \leq χ_B$, where $χ_P$ is the panchromatic number and $α$ is the minimum number of such colors among maximum panchromatic colorings.
